Package com.egradx.core.web

Class EgradxExceptionHandlerSupport

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.core.web.EgradxExceptionHandlerSupport
Direct Known Subclasses:
EgradxApplicationExceptionHandler, EgradxAuditExceptionHandler, EgradxAuthExceptionHandler, EgradxFilesExceptionHandler, EgradxNotificationExceptionHandler, EgradxWebServiceExceptionHandler
public abstract class EgradxExceptionHandlerSupport extends Object
The exception handling every EGRADX web module shares: the exceptions of com.egradx.core.exception and the request errors Spring MVC raises, all answered in EgradxErrorResponse by EgradxErrors' rules.

Extend it with a @RestControllerAdvice: a library scopes its subclass to its own controllers (assignableTypes) and adds handlers for its own exceptions; an application's unscoped subclass answers for the rest (egradx-webservice provides one). respond(org.springframework.http.HttpStatus, java.lang.String, java.lang.String) builds any other answer in the same shape.
